correctness.rationale: The fair-cut covariance influence identity and exact split contribution are reconstructed. Pattern occurrence probabilities, incompatible overlaps, one-endpoint overlaps, and Arratia–Goldstein–Gordon Theorem 1 yield the uniform conditional void error O((j+log n)2^-j). Small and large size windows have negligible contributions, and the central total error is o(1) after multiplying by all n cut locations. The final lattice change gives the explicit A and B series; the Mellin transform proves A nonconstant. The exact independent recurrence agrees with all directly enumerated compositions through n=12 and selected larger asymptotic checks. These finite tests do not establish the infinite statement.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Marginal asymptotics for the support size and asymptotics for part count alone do not algebraically imply their mixed covariance. Maximum-part covariance cannot replace distinct-part-size covariance. Unlike fixed-dimensional CLTs, the displayed log-periodic mixed covariance gathers lengths of order log n and supplies both leading and constant-order periodic profiles. A general marked generating function could in principle produce this identity with additional work, so the residual potential for implicit coverage is expressly retained.

originality.rationale: A direct comparison of theorem statements and implications distinguishes the new two-term K-versus-distinct-size mixed covariance from earlier mean-distinctness, marginal distributions, fixed-size part-count CLTs, and K-versus-largest-part covariance. General Hwang–Yeh marked generating functions may encode the mixed moment and historical implicit coverage is a real residual risk; no novelty is claimed for those generating functions or Poisson approximation.
residual_risks: Marked multiplicity generating functions in Hwang–Yeh are stronger exact encodings and may imply a not-yet-located explicit covariance formula under additional asymptotic analysis.
A historical joint occupancy result under an equivalent renewal-process name might prove the same log-periodic expansion without matching current search keywords.

value.rationale: This concerns natural complexity/diversity observables K (part count) and D (number of different sizes) on the same random composition. Their mixed covariance has a negative logarithmic scale, a genuinely nonconstant periodic leading coefficient, and a separately resolved periodic constant term with absolute o(1) error. It is not a generic restatement of marginal distinctness fluctuations or finite recurrences; the interplay between separator count and long rare runs explains the scale and phase.
